mapper.insert: insert into video (user_id, title, introduction, cover_key, video_key, duration, status) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{introduction}, #{coverKey}, #{videoKey}, #{duration}, #{status})
mapper.select: select v.*, u.nickname, u.avatar_key from video v left join user u on v.user_id=u.id where v.id=#{id}

select v.id, v.title, v.duration, v.cover_key, v.create_time, v.view_count, u.nickname from video v left join user u on v.user_id=u.id
where v.title like CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') or u.nickname like CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')
and v.status = 2 order by v.${orderBy} ${order}
, (v.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) DESC
